summary: One inclusion for all u, w ∈ 𝖴 and all γ; apply it twice.

steps.claim: For all u, w ∈ 𝖴 and all γ: link(γ) ⊆ link(uγw⁻¹). Map the vector t of the definition to u t: u preserves X and acts trivially on X^⊥/X (apply_inr_of_mem_besselU), so ut ⊥ X and (uγw⁻¹)⁻¹(ut) = wγ⁻¹t ⊥ X, and the middle parts of ut and of wγ⁻¹t equal those of t and γ⁻¹t.
steps.lean:
γ := have l {u w γ} : u ∈ _ → w ∈ _ → link γ ≤ link (u * γ * w⁻¹) := fun _ _ _ ↦
    .imp' (u *ᵥ ·) (by simp_all [apply_inr_of_mem_besselU, ← mulVec_mulVec, inv_mulVec_eq_vec rfl,
    mulVec_apply_eq_sum (Units.val _)])
steps.typed_fact: u ∈ _ → w ∈ _ → link γ ≤ link (u * γ * w⁻¹)

steps.claim: With u⁻¹, u'⁻¹ ∈ 𝖴 this gives link(γ) ⊆ link(u⁻¹γu'); with u, u' and the element u⁻¹γu' it gives link(u⁻¹γu') ⊆ link(u u⁻¹γu' u'⁻¹) = link(γ). Hence equality.
